== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[So Be It, Jedi (Errata)]] (<code>1262_11</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 2 • 11), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-11-So_Be_It_Jedi.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-sobeitjedi-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[So Be It, Jedi]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. When Luke dpeloys using your Objective, he deploys to Vader’s site (if possible). Duels initiated with your Objective may not be canceled. Once per game, may ▲ Rise, My Friend. If this Effect canceled by opponent, stack it on Insignificant Rebellion.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1262_11</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 2 • 11 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-11-So_Be_It_Jedi-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B10 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
